guides.favoredWhen: Even. She dodges with E and waits in shroud, so chain where she reappears.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: the E-dodge war decides it.
She hides behind minions at 1: E the angles, not the wave.
She E-dodges your chains: W where her dash ends.

tips.text: Her E2-plus-passive-plus-shroud is the full answer: never chase into the shroud.
Dodge her Q2: the second blast is the damage.
She waits in shroud: chain where she reappears.
Her E2 interrupts dashes: W in, walk out, never W back blind.
Shroud read plus E-dodge won: the Akali who never hides never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Skill matchup. Trade inside W downtime, W from side angles, and play roams over kills.

keyTips.text: Skill matchup: her Charm cancels your W, so the interaction is everything.
Trade around your W cooldown (about {cd:7:W}): no W means no trade.
W from side angles instead of straight in: the angle beats her Charm.

tips.text: She neutralises leads well: bank small edges, do not force.
She out-pushes and is hard to kill: match waves, not egos.
Take Teleport and play for roams and scaling: the kill is optional.
Her Charm answers straight Ws: side-angle every engage.
Angles plus roams: the Ahri who never catches you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: He is the counter-pick against you. Bait E, break Bone Plating early, and never long-lane.

keyTips.text: He picks Viktor into you for a reason: Bone Plating plus range beats your combo.
Bait his E before trading: the ray is his whole answer.
Break Bone Plating with a long Q as he last-hits, then Q+W: the sequence is the trade.

tips.text: Match his TP: the lane is long for both.
Desync backs: reset when he cannot answer.
Long laning means getting E-poked down: close before the grind.
After Bone Plating is broken, Q+W is free: the window repeats.
E baited plus Plating broken plus early close: the Viktor who never zones you never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: She out-tanks and out-bursts you. Hold chain for her jump, and walk off the W pad.

keyTips.text: Shield, tankiness, burst and HP items: walking up gets you jumped.
Hold chain for when she jumps you: the tether answers the engage.
After her Q+W, walk away from your W pad: she has to pick one target.

tips.text: Do not walk up early: her jump punishes every step.
Poke from chain range: E-harass is your safe damage.
Save chain for the jump every fight: no held chain means no answer.
Sidestep the Q: no mark means no engage.
Chain held plus pad split: the Diana who never picks right never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: She wins nothing for free. Stun her dash-in, E-Q back, and match ganks with Mercs.

keyTips.text: She wins the trades: never take the straight exchange.
Her E cancels your W: the stun breaks your combo.
When you dash in, she stuns then E-Qs back: expect the return.

tips.text: Trade only when her E is down: no scatter means no answer.
She has gank setup: track the jungler before trading.
Get Mercs: they buy survival against ganks, not the lane.
W from angles she cannot cover: her E is single-target.
E-dodged plus ganks survived: the Syndra who never stuns you never wins.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: His mobility, shield and Wind Wall blunt everything. Land Q, then W into mimicked W.

keyTips.text: Hard matchup: mobility dodges your W and E, Wind Wall blocks Q and E.
His passive shield acts like Bone Plating: pop it before trading.
After a Q hit, W into mimicked W: neither can be windwalled.

tips.text: Poke around the shield: Q only when the plating is down.
Do not W blindly into held Wall: the block wastes your combo.
The RW trick is the kill: Q-hit then double-W through the Wall.
Track Wind Wall cooldown: Wall-down is your window.
Shield popped plus Wall baited: the Yasuo who never blocks you never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

guides.favoredWhen: Even. Poke his walkups, all-in only with W down, and hold your return for his shadows.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: poke against patience.
Poke when he walks up to CS: his farm attempts are your Qs.
All-in only after his W is down: no shadow means no escape.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Trade from max Q range: his walkup is your window.
Dodge Q, especially with shadows out: the double shuriken is the damage.
He exits R behind you: W back the moment he appears.
Hold your W return until his shadows are used: snap back to safety.
Death Mark lands him behind you: W back to your pad when he ults.
Walkups punished plus W held: the Zed who never dives you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: Built to counter you. Take TP, desync backs, and never Q+W into a full passive bar.

keyTips.text: She is built to counter you: respect the pick, not just the player.
Never Q+W into a full passive bar: her empowered spell cancels your dash.
Space with chain: ranged harass is your only safe damage.

tips.text: Take TP and desync your back timers: stay healthier than her.
Bait her spells before trading: no spells means no counter.
Track her passive bar: full means hands off, spent means go.
Punish spent passives: the window is short.
Passive dodged plus backs desynced: the Vex who never counters you never wins.

sources.author: pumpTM
sources.rankClaim: Rank 1 LeBlanc, 2941LP Challenger (title); Challenger (profile badge) · LeBlanc main

keyTips.text: Play a weaker lane around gank setup and skirmishes instead of forcing a solo lead.
After level 6, trade harder on the relatively short ultimate cooldown.
Remove priority targets with mobility; even a huge chunk can take them out of the coming fight.

tips.text: Punish enemy cooldowns with WEQ or QW inside safe trade windows.
Before level 6, hold the wave near the middle and stage the lane for a jungler gank.
Treat the strong level-2 QW into level-3 kill sequence as conditional, never automatic.
Without an early lead, focus on not falling behind; she scales better than most players expect.
Clear ranged minions with autos first so W wipes them, then surprise with WEQ off their guard.
Clear full waves later by autoing ranged minions once, waiting for low melees, then W-ing across and out.
Run mid-game side lanes for picks and key-target removal in teamfights.
Hold CS even; once Luden's clears waves fast, shove sides before grouping.
Stretch side pressure further than less mobile champions can, while balancing farm against objective timers.
Join objective fights over abandoning the team to 4v5; take side waves only when the team can wait for the rotation.
Poke ahead with Q or QR when an approach opens.
Bank W against unspent key control; patience stops dashes into lockdown.
Peel a teammate with double chain only as the exception; default to deleting squishy targets unless the ADC runs very fed.

itemization.text: Run Electrocute with Sudden Impact, Deep Ward, and Ultimate Hunter plus Manaflow Band and Scorch.
Build Luden's Echo, Sorcerer's Shoes, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, and Zhonya's Hourglass.
